name: Campingplatz Fohnsee
beschreibung: Campingplatz Fohnsee is located in the federal state of Tirol, Österreich. The surroundings are characterized by a mountainous landscape with forests and meadows. Nearby there are hiking trails as well as ski areas for winter sports. The amenities include sanitary facilities and pitches for motorhomes and tents. Guests have access to nearby natural attractions. The site is functional and provides a base for outdoor activities. The site is open year-round.
